story.iWant: a standardized pipeline to invoke Build/Make/Analyze/Deploy actions
story.soThat: I can safely execute improvements in a controlled, traceable manner

tasks.task: Create Pipeline schema (YAML/JSON) with steps, dependencies, timeouts
Create PipelineExecutor class with run, run_step, rollback methods
Create Sandbox class with execute, validate_command methods
Create API endpoints for pipeline execution and status
Create audit trail logging for all pipeline actions

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Pipeline Definition: YAML/JSON schema for pipeline steps
Step Types: build, test, analyze, deploy, rollback
Dependency Graph: Steps can depend on previous steps
PipelineExecutor Class: Runs pipelines in sandboxed environment
Sandbox Isolation: Docker-based or subprocess isolation
Output Capture: Structured logging of all step outputs
Failure Handling: Auto-rollback on step failure
Allowlist Commands: Only pre-approved commands can run
Resource Limits: CPU, memory, time limits
Audit Trail: Every action logged with trace_id

file.reason: Pattern for gating autonomous actions with approval requirements
Pattern for trace_id and audit logging

constraints.constraint: DORMANT: Pipeline execution is NOT auto-triggered until governance approval
All commands must be validated against allowlist before execution
Every action must have trace_id for audit trail
Use subprocess isolation (Docker exec or subprocess.run with limits)
Follow existing logging patterns from observability module

tests.standards: Use pytest with async fixtures. Mock subprocess calls. Test timeout and resource limits. Test rollback on failure.

ideas.idea: Test pipeline YAML parsing with valid/invalid schemas
Test PipelineExecutor runs steps in order
Test audit trail logs all actions
